name: lateral-kneeling-adductor-mobilization
instructions:
1. In an quadruped position, ensure the toes are tucked and the hands are directly underneath the shoulders.
2. Straighten one leg to the side and keep the foot flat on the floor.
3. Exhale and push your hands into the floor to direct your hips backwards to increase the stretch on your groin.
4. Once you run out of range of motion in your adductor, rock back to the starting position and repeat for the assigned number of repetitions on both sides.
